_note: America's Next Top Comic (DESIGN.md "Next Top Comic"; the author's name for the segment): stand-up mini-game using the dialogue system in Monkey Island insult-sword-fighting structure. Sarah Silverman hosts; the player is the contestant and picks a setup, then a punchline, from one shared pool. Just horrible unfunny pairings, but the women in the audience think it's hilarious. 'sources' are the comics whose 'jokes' (data/quotes/<id>.json, setup and punchline as separate lines) are mixed into the pool, fully randomized, so a pairing that happens to fit doesn't matter. 'interjections' (punchlines) and 'openers' (setups) are the author's lines; picking one gets boos, and the judges dock 'steal_penalty' points (an agent placeholder) for stealing jokes from Amy Schumer; the total goes to WorldState comic_points.
title: America's Next Top Comic
